name: Gusto API
summary: Access payroll runs, employee records, and labor cost summaries from Gusto.
whatItDoes: Pulls payroll history, scheduled pay runs, employee wages, and employer tax burdens — core data for payroll forecasting and hiring affordability workflows.
privacyNotes: Payroll data is highly sensitive PII. Partner approval may be required. Never store SSNs or bank details in AI prompts.
